portraits.name: Bokusei
portraits.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: final production character selection illustration for an Unreal fantasy RPG, vertical 1024x1536 transparent PNG. Input image 1 is the EXISTING CHARACTER whose identity, sex, hairstyle, hair/eye colors, costume design, accessories and color palette must remain recognizable. Input images 2-4 are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: fine confident hand-inked outlines of varied weight, expressive simplified anime face, flatter graphic shadow shapes combined with restrained softly painted material shading, flowing elegant hair strands, richly drawn fantasy garment details like the supplied classic Korean fantasy RPG illustrations. Substantially redraw the character into that illustrative visual language; avoid the existing glossy generic rendered look. Single character only, natural characterful elegant pose, head to upper thigh composition, face in upper third, full head/hair/accessories and both shoulders inside frame, balanced centered silhouette with small transparent margins. Keep clothing coverage and anatomy natural. BACKGROUND MUST BE COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT with real alpha: no scenery, no colored rectangle, no mist, no stars, no ground, no cast shadow, no border, no decorative backdrop, no floating props, no checkerboard painted into pixels. Absolutely NO text, letters, logos, signature, watermark or UI. Only the character cutout. Preserve fine clean alpha edges of hair and clothing. Character: Bokusei
